amendments.correction_reason: Kernel COMPLETE and submitted as 56297442. Paired reference stock-sweep-harmonic-v1 submitted as 56294968. Important caveat for interpretation: the two arms did NOT select the same post-process override. With D4 off the sweep chose tight55; with D4 on it chose relaxed9, which had been the worst candidate in the D4-off table. The pair is therefore a best-configuration comparison, not a clean isolation of the correction. On the 8 held-out TRAIN movies D4 raises base proxy 0.9490380 to 0.9496698 and division Jaccard 0.2308 to 0.2857.

Leaderboard returned 0.940 against the paired stock reference 56294968 at 0.947. The complete-D4 geometry correction is REJECTED: it costs about 0.007 on the hidden set. Every local and proxy signal pointed the other way - 4-movie diagnostic +0.002781, 8-movie base proxy 0.9490380 to 0.9496698, division Jaccard 0.2308 to 0.2857 - and all of them were wrong about the sign. The most likely reading is that the public checkpoints and every downstream threshold were calibrated around the seven-unique-view behaviour, so correcting the geometry invalidates that calibration.
